simple.meaning: אָוָה (ʼâvâh) is a Hebrew action word meaning “to extend or mark out.” BibleIQ anchors the English reading to this source verb before comparing its uses.
simple.biblicalBackground: This action appears 1 time in Numbers, beginning at Numbers 34:10. Its meaning becomes clearer as the uses are compared.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to אָוָה (H184) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Actions in Scripture show what people do, what God does, and how covenant faithfulness or rebellion is described. BibleIQ compares the action across its occurrences.
simple.summary: אָוָה (ʼâvâh) / H184 is traced through Numbers 34:10 with source-language evidence and verse context.
